RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Online Form 2026 (2005 Posts) - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Ltd (RRVUNL) has released the Short Notice for the post of Junior Engineer, Junior Assistant. This recruitment was released for 2005 posts. Applications for the RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Online Form 2026 will Start from 05 August 2026, & Candidate can apply until 25 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : Available Soon
  • Application Start Date : 05 August 2026 (Tentative)
  • Last Date : 25 August 2026 (Tentative)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 August 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : 1000/-
  • SC, ST, EBC, MBC, BC, EWS : 500/
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
